## About
RPM Performance is a classic and modern muscle car and hot rod shop on South East Street, just south of downtown Indianapolis. We started out in a garage shop in Westfield, building performance, racing and restoration project cars, and grew into the facility we're in now.
Under one roof we've got engine and chassis dynos, a performance parts department, a paint booth and body shop, a nitrous fill station, and a full service shop for fabrication, custom exhaust, engine building and interior restoration. Partial or frame-off restorations, resto mods, or performance upgrades on your Mustang or Camaro, we'll take it on.
Bob Mandabach is our general manager. Give us a call and you'll be talking to a car enthusiast. We're rated 4.3 from 52 Google reviews.

## Services
- Restorations: Anything from a partial restoration to a full frame-off build.
- Engines: Standard engines all the way up to the wildest race engines.
- Engine Performance Upgrades: More power for the car that left the factory a little slow.
- Header & Exhaust Installations: Headers and exhaust work, including custom exhaust systems.
- Dent & Rust Repair: Body work done in our own body shop.
- Paint & Scratch Repair: Paint work out of our paint booth.
- Full Interior Restoration: Upholstery, trim, carpet, headliner, door panels and more.
- Locating Hard to Find Parts: We'll help track down the parts your build needs.

## FAQ
Q: Where are you located?
A: 3202 South East Street, just south of downtown Indianapolis.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Whether it's a Mustang or a Camaro, a vintage automobile or a souped-up muscle car, bring it in.

Q: Do you do resto mods?
A: Yes. We do resto mods along with frame-off restorations, engine mods and racing performance work.

## What customers say
- "The engine in my 1985 Silverado shortbed had a Crack in the block and locked up. So I did my research and was able to get an amazing deal on a 383 Stroker from Blueprint Engines. I called a shop and they said it would be awhile before they would be able to install it. I received the engine in June. By the time October came around I was tired of waiting. I contacted a person in my local car community and he recommended RPM Performance.
RPM Performance was able to get me in the next week. It took a few days and the engine was installed by a gentleman named Jim. Jim did an amazing job! The engine it tuned wonderfully. The power is amazing. The transmission has a 2500rpm stall converter and a shift kit. I drove the truck home and it was amazing. The next morning there was transmission fluid all over my garage floor. A couple days later she was back in the shop. I had the transmission rebuilt and it still leaked. So after the truck being in an out of shop Bob ( the owner ) put a new transmission in my truck. I changed the rear gear from a 3.08 to a 3.73. Since I had the rear end apart, I had an Eaton posi installed.
Bob and RPM Performance has stood by me when I was having problems with my TH350 transmission. They are good people who stand by their work." (Wallace Flowers, 5/5)
